style: instrumental video game main theme, seamless 90 second loop. The title screen of a hand-drawn satirical startup survival game: a small deadpan creature sprints down a runway paved with burning money, holding its laptop and houseplant. Mood: hopeful, mischievous, slightly reckless — running toward a bright future that is clearly on fire, played completely straight. A catchy, hummable 4-bar trumpet motif (warm, lightly muted, precise, never brassy-epic) leads over driving felt piano eighth notes; marimba answers with a playful countermelody; round upright bass walks; tight dry drum kit with rimshots and finger snaps pushes forward; glockenspiel sparkles on turnarounds; one subtle synth pluck keeps it modern. Small-room, dry, intimate modern production, humanized timing like a hand-played band. Structure: motif, motif with countermelody, piano-led lift, turnaround straight back to the top. 96 BPM, F major. No vocals, no orchestra, no chiptune, no EDM, no intro, no outro, no fade-out.
